title: Global Economic Data + Base Pricing — the 21 zero-evidence programs

summary.note: Of the original 21: 1 (on_ofttc) has since been researched from scratch and canonicalized (see its RESOLVED field above) -- VERIFIED tier, real DoctrineRecord/RateRule/SourceProvenance, coverage veto removed, though a disclosed discovery-layer limitation currently prevents it from being independently served alongside ca_on_opstc (same jurisdiction_code). Of the remaining 20: 18 have literally zero data in any canonical source this project maintains (RateRule, DoctrineRecord, jurisdiction_comparison profile, or global_inventory catalog). 2 have an adjacent citation or codebase reference that has not been individually confirmed to apply to this specific canonical_program_id — both still require primary-source research before either identity-merge or rate promotion.
